eyebrow: The first thing that trips people up
code:
-- Does NOT work in SOQL:
SELECT * FROM Opportunity

-- Required instead:
SELECT Id, Name, Amount, StageName,
       CloseDate
FROM Opportunity
caption: Deliberate — tied to API cost and governor limits.
